scenario.claim_text: The owner discovers a new preferred finish change after substantial completion and tries to add it to the punch list sixty-five days later. The source-safe answer is to reject that as a normal punch-list addition. CIAP Document 102 limits additions to corrective work on original punch-list items and only within the allowed period after substantial completion.
